controles.verbatim_source: with an investment of EUR206m in share repurchases in the half year, net of proceeds from exercise of Long Term Incentives
controles.correction_proposee: Precision disponible : 230 M€ bruts pour 3 653 476 actions a 63,04 € en moyenne ; 206 M€ est l'impact net de tresorerie.

controles.affirmation: Citation du PDG : la croissance organique n'est pas encore revenue a un niveau normal
controles.verbatim_source: Organic revenue growth has not yet returned to a normal level, although there was improvement as H1 progressed.
Revenues of EUR3,701m increased by 2.5% as reported ... and 2.7% organically13
Le communique S1 2026 ne reprend pas le T1 : il donne le T2 2026 a 3,0% organique. Aucun document T1 2026 ne figure dans data-lake/ERF.PA/ir ni dans les _sources de l'ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par la donnee publiee : 3,0% de croissance organique au T2 2026 contre 2,7% sur le semestre, ce qui montre une acceleration et non une stagnation.

controles.affirmation: En Europe, la croissance organique n'etait que de 1,7% au T1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Le communique S1 2026 donne Europe : organique +2,0% sur le S1 et +2,3% au T2 2026. Aucun 1,7% dans les sources citees.
controles.correction_proposee: Europe : +2,0% organique au S1 2026 et +2,3% au T2 2026. Le chiffre trimestriel T1 cite est perime et introuvable dans les sources.

controles.affirmation: Europe, premiere zone du groupe avec 52,5% du chiffre d'affaires 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Europe 3,829 52% du total FY 2025 sur 7,296 total (URD FY2025) = 52,5%

controles.affirmation: Frein lie a la rationalisation de contrats de diagnostic clinique deficitaires herites de Synlab en Espagne et en Italie
controles.verbatim_source: In Diagnostics, revenue growth was affected by the divestment of an entity in the Netherlands in January, and the implementation of the planned rationalisation of certain loss-making Clinical Diagnostics contracts in the former SYNLAB business in Spain and in Italy.

controles.affirmation: La famille Martin detient 35,2% du capital mais 69,1% des droits de vote au 31 decembre 2025 ; le flottant porte 61,7% du capital et 30,9% des droits de vote ; le mecanisme peut encore etre renforce par l'emission de parts supplementaires
controles.verbatim_source: The Martin family ... held 35.2% of the shares, with 69.1% of the voting rights in Eurofins as of 31 December 2025. The free float represents 61.7% of the shares and 30.9% of the voting rights ... allows them to further increase their percentage of voting rights in Eurofins through the issuance of additional beneficiary units. (URD FY2025, 5.5.9)

controles.affirmation: ...contre 32,8% du capital et 67,0% des droits de vote fin 2024
controles.verbatim_source: The Martin family ... held 32.9% of the shares, with 67.1% of the voting rights in Eurofins as of 31 December 2024. (URD FY2024, 5.5.9)
controles.correction_proposee: 32,9% du capital et 67,1% des droits de vote fin 2024.

controles.affirmation: Preuve citee pour le risque reglementaire : 'severe, including the remote possibility of a cessation of the business'
controles.verbatim_source: If this were to be the case, the impact on Eurofins' net worth, financial position and operating results could be severe, including the remote possibility of a cessation of the business. (URD FY2025, 5.1.1)
controles.correction_proposee: Le fragment cite est le pire scenario, explicitement qualifie de 'remote', d'un enchainement conditionnel (crise economique -> suspension de reglementations). Citer plutot la phrase utile : 'governments may be forced to suspend or revoke regulations and reduce testing frequency to ease their financial burden, which would directly impact the testing industry'.

controles.affirmation: Les gouvernements peuvent suspendre ou reduire les obligations d'analyse pour alleger leur charge budgetaire
controles.verbatim_source: governments may be forced to suspend or revoke regulations and reduce testing frequency to ease their financial burden, which would directly impact the testing industry

controles.affirmation: Les droits de douane sont DESORMAIS cites explicitement parmi les risques de l'exercice 2025
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : 'changes in local economic or political conditions e.g. trade tariffs)' et 'governmental policies such as tariffs, penalties, restrictions and sanctions'. Mais les MEMES formulations figurent deja dans l'URD FY2024 : 'changes in local economic or political conditions (e.g., Brexit, trade tariffs)' et 'governmental policies such as tariffs, penalties, restrictions and sanctions'.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer 'desormais' : ce n'est pas une nouveaute de l'exercice 2025. Attention aussi au faux ami : les 'tariff cuts' evoques ailleurs dans l'URD designent les baisses de TARIFS DE REMBOURSEMENT des analyses cliniques de routine en France (10 septembre 2024), pas des droits de douane.

controles.affirmation: Litige en cours sur des contaminants biologiques dans des produits laitiers en Europe ; responsabilite non prouvee, dommages ni etablis ni chiffres
controles.verbatim_source: An on-going litigation that could cause significant financial or reputational damage for Eurofins continues in the context of the detection of biological contaminants in dairy products in Europe. The Group's responsibility has not been proven and the damages that are claimed have been neither established nor measured. (URD FY2025, note 2.36)

controles.affirmation: Procedure contre les anciens actionnaires d'Eurofins Genoma Group en Italie, 27,5 M€ de complement de prix provisionne dont le montant final depend de l'issue
controles.verbatim_source: The Group has entered into legal proceedings against the former shareholders of Eurofins Genoma Group Srl in Italy for breach of non-compete and other contractual clauses ... EUR27.5m has been accrued ... The final amount payable is subject to the legal proceedings.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision d'equilibre omise : 'the Group considers that the outcome of these disputes and legal claims currently in progress is unlikely to have a significant adverse impact'.

controles.affirmation: Exfiltration de donnees chez une filiale neerlandaise ; decision de justice non susceptible d'appel pas attendue avant 2027 ; risque juge remote et d'effet limite pour le groupe
controles.verbatim_source: one smaller Dutch clinical diagnostics affiliate ... fell victim to an unauthorised data exfiltration by a new hackers' collective ... which decision is not expected before 2027 in principle. The Group is of the opinion that the risks ... are remote due to a number of reasons and considerations and would be of limited effect on the Group as a whole. (URD FY2025, 5.3.6)
controles.correction_proposee: L'URD precise aussi 'As of 31 December 2025, the Group had no material cases related to data protection risk', a mentionner pour l'equilibre.

controles.affirmation: Une amende RGPD peut atteindre jusqu'a 4% du chiffre d'affaires mondial annuel
controles.verbatim_source: Breaches of GDPR can result in the imposition of a fine equivalent to up to 4% of Eurofins' total worldwide annual turnover from the preceding financial year.

EBITDA3 losses on the non-mature scope startup & in integration perimeter ... continued to reduce to EUR8m ; The adjusted1 EBITDA3 margin on total revenues18 objective for FY 2027 remains 24%.

controles.affirmation: 212 M€ de capex net au S1 2026, -15,6% sur un an ; capex operationnel net cible ~400 M€/an plus ~200 M€/an sur les sites propres en 2026-2027
